# A press overtakes its coalesced mousemove, so a click orbits GraphScene

## Context

Found while wiring click selection into the Institution's Observatory (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#271, PR neomjs/neo-agent-institution#272), whose renderer extends `Neo.canvas.GraphScene`. An NL arm that clicked a node after an orbit and a zoom selected nothing. The node had been orbited away at the press.

Probe (Institution NL harness, engine `a50ae57ce8`): the pointer rests at A for 200 ms, then `page.mouse.click(B)` jumps 400 px right and 200 px down and presses within one frame. The camera went from `{yaw: 0.7, pitch: 0.32, touched: false}` to `{yaw: 3.1, pitch: 1.45, touched: true}`: 400 px × `orbitSpeed` 0.006 = 2.4 rad of yaw, and pitch clamped at 1.45. One click rotated the scene by 2.4 rad.

## The Problem

`src/main/DomEvents.mjs` coalesces `mousemove` into the next animation frame. `onMouseMove` stores `lastMouseMoveData` and schedules `flushMouseMove` with `requestAnimationFrame`, the #8654 perf change. `onMouseDown`, `onMouseUp`, `onClick`, `onWheel` and `onMouseLeave` send at once. A move and a press inside one frame therefore reach the App worker as press-then-move.

`Neo.canvas.Base#updateMouseState` derives `dx`/`dy` from the last reported position. The press report carries the whole unreported jump with `buttons: 1`, and `GraphScene#updateMouseState` orbits on exactly that combination. The late move lands afterwards. The same ordering hands a canvas a move after its `leave`, which re-arms a pointer that has left. Real hands hit this with a fast flick-and-click inside one frame, and on touch, where a tap arrives at a new position with no move before it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `DomEvents#onMouseMove` / `#flushMouseMove` (the coalescing, `mouseMoveReqId`) and the press handlers `onMouseDown`, `onMouseUp`, `onClick`, `onDoubleClick`, `onContextMenu`, `onWheel`, `onMouseEnter`, `onMouseLeave`, each a direct `sendMessageToApp`.
- Consumers relying on move-before-press order: `Neo.app.SharedCanvas` → `Neo.canvas.Base#updateMouseState` (`dx`/`dy`), `Neo.canvas.GraphScene#updateMouseState` (orbit), and any App-side listener pairing a move with the following press.
- Existing spec surface: `test/playwright/unit/main/DomEvents.spec.mjs`.

## The Fix

Before sending any other mouse event, `DomEvents` flushes a pending coalesced move: cancel `mouseMoveReqId` and call `flushMouseMove()` at the top of the press, release, click, wheel, context menu and enter/leave handlers, or in one helper they share. Moves stay coalesced to at most one per frame when nothing else intervenes. `GraphScene` needs no change once order holds.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: a pending coalesced `mousemove` reaches the App worker before a following mousedown, mouseup, click, dblclick, contextmenu, wheel, mouseenter or mouseleave (a `DomEvents.spec` arm with a stubbed `sendMessageToApp` and `requestAnimationFrame`, red on dev).
- [ ] AC-2: with nothing intervening, moves inside one frame still send once, carrying the last position.
- [ ] AC-3 (post-merge): on an engine pin carrying the fix, the Institution's Observatory NL `selectNode` helper drops its pointer rest, and the click still selects. The helper documents the workaround and cites this ticket. Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#277 (the pin that carries this fix).

## Out of Scope

- Moving the drag sensors to Pointer Events (`#17889`).
- Any change to `GraphScene`'s orbit rule.

## Related

`#8654` (the coalescing), `#19173` / `#19179` (the canvas host's wheel/drag forwarding), neomjs/neo-agent-institution#272.
